about.title: Knowledge that travels from screen to soil.
about.intro: Agri Pulse is a bilingual agriculture information hub made for practical learning.
about.body: We bring together clear field notes, educational videos, and useful reference material in Tamil and English. The goal is simple: help farmers, students, and agriculture teams make their next good decision with more context and confidence.
about.principle1Text: Every story should answer a real question or open a useful next step.
about.principle2Text: Important ideas deserve to be available in the language people think and work in.
about.principle3Text: Sample content is labeled. Published content can include its source or credit for review.
